company.description: Tenor Partners is an advisory of independent marketing and investor relations professionals who bring senior expertise to critical private investor milestones - the launch of a new fund, a new thesis, a new GP - a campaign to create opportunity and influence - the relaunch or repositioning of a firm. Our fund marketing and investor relations experience ranges broadly across the alternative asset class from pre-seed operator funds to early-stage venture, to syndicate networks, growth equity, equity buyouts, and several advanced tech-enabled investment vehicles and structures.
